questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
A vicious cycle
options: 1) a situation in which one problem causes another one, making the original problem impossible to solve.
2) a situation in which one problem causes another one, making the first one easy tosolve.
3) a situation in which one problem creates another one, making the original problem easy to forget.
4) a situation in which several problems merge and become one extremely complex problem.
questions.solution: A) A vicious cycle (idiom) –a situation in which one problem causes another one, making the original problem impossible to solve.एक स्थिति जिसमें एक समस्या दूसरी समस्या पैदा करती है,जिससे मूल समस्या को हल करना असंभव हो जाता है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
I have been living without a lot of money since I lost my job
options: 4) as genuine as a three-dollar bill
questions.solution:
B)‘living without a lot of money' के बदले 'living hand to mouth' का use होगा क्योंकि यह idiom कठिन परिस्थितियों में जीवन यापन करने का अर्थ देता है; जैसे—
I have been living hand to mouth since I lost my job.
•'living hand to mouth'will be used instead of 'living without a lot of money' because this idiom means living in difficult conditions; Like—
